pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo!
en: The weather is lovely today!
speaker: friend-a

pinyin: Shì a, yìqǐ zǒuzou ba.
en: It is! Let's take a little walk together.
speaker: friend-b
note: 走走 makes the suggestion relaxed; 吧 softens it.

pinyin: Hē bēi chá zěnmeyàng?
en: How about a cup of tea?
speaker: friend-a
note: A conversational suggestion. The full form is 喝一杯茶怎么样？

pinyin: Hǎo a, zǒu ba!
en: Sounds good. Let's go!
speaker: friend-b
note: 好啊 is a friendly way to agree.

pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de miànbāo zhēn xiāng.
en: The bread from that shop smells so good.
speaker: friend-a

zh: 我早上买了一个，还不错。
pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang mǎi le yí ge, hái búcuò.
en: I bought one this morning. It was pretty good.
speaker: friend-b
note: 还不错 is a relaxed way to say pretty good.

pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zài kàn shénme shū?
en: What have you been reading lately?
speaker: friend-a

zh: 一本故事书。每天看一点儿。
pinyin: Yì běn gùshi shū. Měitiān kàn yìdiǎnr.
en: A storybook. I read a little every day.
speaker: friend-b

zh: 中午吃什么？我有点儿饿了。
pinyin: Zhōngwǔ chī shénme? Wǒ yǒudiǎnr è le.
en: What shall we eat for lunch? I'm getting a little hungry.
speaker: friend-a

pinyin: Chī miàn ba, nàbiān yǒu jiā xiǎo diàn.
en: Let's have noodles. There's a little place over there.
speaker: friend-b

pinyin: Wǎnshang qù hébiān zǒuzou?
en: Shall we take a walk by the river tonight?
speaker: friend-a

pinyin: Hǎo a, chī wán fàn zài qù.
en: Sure. Let's go after dinner.
speaker: friend-b

pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán zhēn piàoliang!
en: This park is really pretty!
speaker: friend-a

pinyin: Shì a, héhuā kāi de zhènghǎo.
en: Yeah, the lotus flowers are blooming just right.
speaker: friend-b

pinyin: Nǐ kàn, nàxiē yú!
en: Look at those fish!
speaker: friend-a

pinyin: Tāmen hǎoxiàng zài děng rén wèishí.
en: They look like they're waiting to be fed.
speaker: friend-b

zh: 这家馄饨摊看起来不错。
pinyin: Zhè jiā húntun tān kànqǐlái búcuò.
en: This wonton stall looks good.
speaker: friend-a

pinyin: Wǒmen qù chángchang ba.
en: Let's go try it.
speaker: friend-b
note: 尝尝 (chángchang) — to have a taste.

pinyin: Zǎodiǎn chī le ma?
en: Have you had breakfast yet?
speaker: friend-a

pinyin: Hái méi, wǒmen qù mǎi yóutiáo ba.
en: Not yet — let's go buy some youtiao.
speaker: friend-b

pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān bèi le duōshao shēngcí?
en: How many new words did you memorize today?
speaker: friend-a

pinyin: Chàbuduō shí ge ba.
en: About ten, I'd guess.
speaker: friend-b

pinyin: Zhè lǐ hěn ānjìng, shìhé kànshū.
en: It's quiet here — good for reading.
speaker: friend-a

zh: 对啊，我最喜欢来这儿学习。
pinyin: Duì a, wǒ zuì xǐhuan lái zhèr xuéxí.
en: Right, I like coming here to study best of all.
speaker: friend-b
